messages.content: You are a coding agent working in a repository through tools. Read files before you change them, keep edits small, run the tests after every change, and answer with the change you made and why. Never invent file contents: call read_file or grep first. Prefer minimal diffs over rewrites. When a tool fails, say what failed and try one different approach before asking the user.
Our `RateLimiter` allows a burst, then refills one token per second. I want a `try_acquire_n(n)` that takes n tokens atomically or none.
The existing method is a one-token special case, so it can delegate to the new one without changing behaviour.
Yes, make `try_acquire` call `try_acquire_n(1)`. Also say what `try_acquire_n(0)` and `try_acquire_n` with n above the capacity should do, and add a test for each.
